question: What will be the value of cosx × cosecx - sinx × secx?
solution:
Given:

cos x cosec x - sin x sec x

Concept used:

1. cos²x - sin²x = cos 2x

2. 2 × sinx × cosx = sin 2x

3. cot x = cos x ÷ sin x

Calculation:

cosx × cosecx - sinx × secx

⇒ frac {cosx}{sinx} - frac {sinx}{cosx}

⇒ frac {cos²x - sin²x}{sinx . cosx }

⇒ 2 × frac {cos 2x}{2sinx . cosx}

⇒ 2 × frac {cos 2x}{sin 2x}

⇒ 2cot 2x

**∴ The simplified value is 2cot 2x.**
